purpose: World-map painted ground experiment (#9464); generated 2026-10-05 via codex-image-gen (GPT image), resized to 1024 RGBA

prompts.meadow: Seamless tileable square ground texture for a fantasy strategy-game world map seen from high above at map scale, like a hand-painted campaign map in the spirit of Mount & Blade. Stylized painterly brush work with soft broad colour variation and gentle mottling, flat top-down orthographic view with no perspective, no horizon, no shadows from a single direction, even lighting. The texture must tile seamlessly on all four edges. Square, around 1024x1024. NO text, NO letters, NO figures, NO objects, NO trees, NO buildings, NO paths, NO border or frame; ground surface only. Low-to-medium contrast so it reads well when repeated many times. Subject: lush green meadow grassland, varied fresh and olive greens with faint warm patches.
